terminology_notes: The uploaded revised edition explicitly separates perceived affordances from signifiers; this package preserves that distinction.
The source treats discoverability and understanding as distinct but related aims of good design.
The source distinguishes slips from mistakes by intention/plan versus execution, so this package never uses user error as a root cause.
edition_specific_terminology: signifiers emphasized in the revised edition
human-centered design and design thinking chapters reflect the revised/expanded edition
retitling from The Psychology of Everyday Things to The Design of Everyday Things is recorded as publication history
visual_extraction_warnings: EPUB figure images were inventoried and contact-sheet inspected; fine labels inside small figures were not OCR-transcribed.
No stable print page numbers were encoded in the EPUB; source traceability uses XHTML file anchors and NCX section anchors.
limitations: EPUB anchors substitute for page numbers.
Figure content is referenced by image filename/caption/nearby text rather than reproducing images or long case narratives.
Operational software and AI-agent records are labeled as extensions, not direct claims from the book.
